Q5962.reason: Under FRE 611(c) and 607, leading questions are allowed for a witness identified with an adverse party, and any party may impeach a witness.

Q5964.reason: Failure to act despite a legal duty and knowledge of the danger can support involuntary manslaughter through reckless omission.

Q5965.reason: Conspiracy punishes the agreement, so impossibility, whether legal or factual, is not a defense.
